title: What nature teaches us about product distribution
summary: Building software is easier. Distribution remains hard. What seeds, bees and shared incentives can teach us about helping products spread.
author: Sriram Srinivasan

title: How Products Found Their Customers — 01 Dropbox
summary: Dropbox rewarded referrals with more of what customers already valued: storage. The lesson is to make discovery valuable for everyone involved.
author: Sriram Srinivasan

sources.title: Dropbox: Dropbox referrals are now twice as nice! (3 April 2012)
